NX25.target: reported ASOS sustained wind speed at +60 minutes
NX25.cost: two declared scalar features per policy; no acquisition superiority claim
NX25.primary_score: held-out mean absolute error on identical complete cases
NX25.uncertainty: seed 25030 day-block bootstrap 512 replicates; descriptive small-sample interval

NX27.coarse: non-overlapping 15-minute averages of three exact samples
NX27.target: mean reported wind over next 15-minute block
NX27.models: training-only scalar AR(1) separately at fine and coarse cadence
NX27.comparison: coarse vs fine numerical model predictions and each vs measured window reported separately
NX27.scope: temporal averaging benchmark, not a spatial atmospheric multiscale validation

NX28.site: 25-025-0042 if both species complete; otherwise earliest lexical common site
NX28.target: next-day arithmetic mean ozone ppm for 1-hour sample duration
NX28.mechanism: two-species reduced discrete loss/conversion family; fitted rate with no claim of named atmospheric mechanism validity
NX28.primary_score: next-day MAE on identical complete dates

NX29_NX30.source: recovered official NFL BDB 2027 restricted input archives; raw rows remain private
NX29_NX30.selection: first 20 lexical official nfl_id with valid 2023 or 2024 combine attempts and future game outcome
NX29_NX30.split: draft cohort chronological plus player-held-out; earliest cohort train, latest evaluation
NX29_NX30.target: mean future player_get_off on valid non-nullified matched plays
NX29_NX30.NX29_extra: identified bilinear movement target plus exact design rank and uncertainty
NX29_NX30.NX30_extra: level-two x,y,time signatures of combine attempt; full attempt available at deployment
NX29_NX30.segmentation: at most eight candidate boundaries, three phases; no evaluation outcome in extraction
NX29_NX30.primary_score: held-out squared error on identical athletes
NX29_NX30.calibration: training residual radius and held-out coverage
NX29_NX30.restriction: publish aggregates/source hashes only, no individual restricted trajectories or fitted per-player outputs

amendments_before_fitting.reason: Official schema uses forty/vertical/combine_weight, and lexical IDs could select a single cohort. Freeze balanced chronological cohorts before extracting outcome values or fitting.
amendments_before_fitting.athlete_selection: first ten lexical eligible IDs in each 2023 and 2024 draft cohort; twenty maximum
amendments_before_fitting.split: train 2023 cohort; evaluate 2024 cohort; disjoint nfl_id namespaces verified

amendments_before_fitting.reason: EPA anonymous bulk endpoints timed out twice before any chemical measurements were obtained. Switch to maintainer-distributed R airquality primary benchmark before fitting.
amendments_before_fitting.target: next-day mean ozone at 1300-1500 hours ppb
amendments_before_fitting.model: positive open-box O3 -> unobserved sink with constant source: c_next=rho*c+b; rho grid0..1 step1/100; b>=0 training-only least squares
amendments_before_fitting.primary_score: next-day MAE on identical consecutive observed days
amendments_before_fitting.scope: empirical reduced one-species loss/source mismatch; no named atmospheric mechanism validation; no latent species scored as measured
